title: Partner co-sell pipeline review - Apollo Partners
summary: Weekly co-sell pipeline review with Apollo Partners to align on top 6 deals, clarify responsibilities, discuss obstacles (security, latency, pricing), and agree next steps for joint outreach and pilots.
topics: Technical blockers: VPC/on-prem and data residency
transcript:
00:00 Maya Chen: Hey everyone, thanks for joining, uh we'll run about an hour, agenda is quick pipeline review and deal strategy. 00:12 Liam O'Neill: Yeah thanks Maya, appreciate it. We've got Priya and Samir on, and Renee for any technical Qs. 00:25 Jordan Reyes: Hi all, Jordan from Redwood, SE, I'll jump in on technical calls and runbooks. 00:33 Priya Singh: Quick call out, we're trying to surface three logo plays for Q3, need clarity on who leads outreach. 00:45 Maya Chen: Great, we'll go deal by deal. First one: Orion Health, it's in evaluation, expected close mid-Aug. Priya, where are we on exec buy-in? 00:59 Priya Singh: Exec buy-in looks ok, CFO needs clear TCO. They're pushing hard on hosted vs dedicate, uh-- sorry Dedicated. 01:12 Samir Patel: Orion also asked about VPC and on-prem options for PHI, they mentioned SOC2 and HIPAA compliance. 01:24 Jordan Reyes: Technically we can support VPC peering, and Private on-prem options, but provisioning timeline for a private deploy is about 6-8 weeks, and we need infra approvals. 01:38 Renee Park: For Orion specifically, they require KMS integration and audit logs, are those in your compliance pack? 01:46 Maya Chen: Yes we have docs, I'll share the SOC2 and KMS integration guide after the call. Link: https://redwood.example.com/soc2-kms (note: placeholder). 01:58 Liam O'Neill: Perfect. Next deal: Meridian Systems - big opportunity, POC requested, estimate 30-60k ARR. 02:10 Maya Chen: Meridian is showing latency sensitivities, they are worried about multi-region consistency and token costs. Jordan, any recommendations? 02:21 Jordan Reyes: For latency sensitive apps we usually recommend Dedicated pool with autoscaling; also suggest caching prefix responses to reduce token spend. There's a tradeoff on unit cost vs latency. 02:35 Priya Singh: Competitor mention - they evaluated OrbitalAI and Equinox, Orbital pushed lower priced hosted but no private option. 02:48 Maya Chen: We'll position Redwood Dedicated + Optimize consult to show unit-economics. Offer to run a cost/latency spreadsheet. I'll send a joint benchmark template. 03:02 Samir Patel: Action: Samir to own Meridian outreach with Priya on messaging. 03:12 Maya Chen: Noted. Next: Nova Retail - procurement stage, legal flagged indemnity and data residency. 03:24 Liam O'Neill: Nova wants EU-only data residency and separate audit trail per tenant. 03:34 Jordan Reyes: We can do region pinning and per-tenant audit logs; need to involve our data controls PM for the SOW. 03:45 Priya Singh: Timeline? They expect production in Q4. If legal slows, close may slip. 03:53 Maya Chen: We'll prioritize SOW template and legal playbook. I'll loop in legal and send redlines by Friday. 04:05 Maya Chen: Quick check on two smaller deals: Atmos Labs and Helix Integrations, both need POC scope. 04:15 Samir Patel: Atmos is price sensitive, might go with quantized model variants. 04:23 Jordan Reyes: Quantization is fine for embeddings and many gen flows, but watch for quality regressions on complex prompts; we recommend baseline evals. 04:35 Liam O'Neill: On the topic of pilots, can the SE run a bench for 10k tokens/minute sim to show throughput? 04:45 Jordan Reyes: Yes, we can run a synthetic benchmark; we have a co-sell benchmark sheet: https://redwood.example.com/cosell-benchmarks (placeholder). We'll need sample prompts and target QPS. 04:58 Maya Chen: Excellent. I'm hearing the main blockers: legal/SOW, private/VPC provisioning timelines, and pricing clarity. 05:07 Priya Singh: Can we get a margin expectation? Apollo wants to know partner cut and list vs net. 05:16 Maya Chen: We'll propose a tiered margin in the co-sell playbook; I'll include redlineable terms. 05:24 Liam O'Neill: Also need clarity on who presents to the exec on deal handoffs. 05:30 Maya Chen: For enterprise deals, Redwood AE plus Apollo AE present, SE joins for deep dives. We'll document in playbook. 05:40 Samir Patel: Quick technical Q: how does KV cache behave across shards? We've seen stale state previously. 05:50 Jordan Reyes: KV cache is per-instance; with sharding we maintain strong consistency for active sessions but prefix cache hit rates vary; can share our caching whitepaper. 06:06 Maya Chen: Okay let's go through deal-by-deal quick status (timestamp jumps for brevity) 15:00 Orion Health - next: joint exec briefing week of 2026-08-03. 20:12 Meridian Systems - POC start targeted 2026-07-30, Samir to lead outreach. 28:40 Nova Retail - legal SOW review expected by 2026-07-24. 34:15 Atmos Labs - POC scoping doc needed, Jordan to draft. 42:00 Helix Integrations - pricing negotiation, customer requested 10% discount as reseller margin. 49:30 FourEyes Media - new prospect introduced by Apollo, initial discovery next week. 55:00 Maya Chen: Recap and next steps, we'll share playbook and proposals, schedule exec briefing, run bench, and align owner list. 55:22 Priya Singh: Thanks team, we'll prioritize Orion and Meridian. 55:40 Maya Chen: Great thanks everyone, I'll send notes and links. 55:50 Liam O'Neill: Appreciate it, bye. 55:56 All: bye.

Note: Transcription has occasional errors, e.g., 'Dedicate' instead of 'Dedicated', 'OrbitalAI' misheard as 'Orible AI' in some past exports, and proper nouns sometimes spelled imperfectly.
